bio: The patterned wallpaper and understated class of this posh establishment are obvious right from the first minute, but it is the alfresco patio that will win your heart. Every detail counts from the first hello to the last farewell. Yijiangnan specialises in straightforward, generous Chinese cuisine. Rather than a never-ending menu, you will find family favourites such as Peking duck, together with a few more modern creations. All the better when you know that the prices won’t break the bank....
